name: f-ytree
caption: An impressionist oil painting, loose visible broken brushstrokes, thick impasto dabs of pure color, soft atmospheric light, simple bold composition that stays readable when shrunk to a tiny phone thumbnail. (photo:-2) (3d:-2) (vector:-2) (anatomy:-2) Pale blue and rose dawn light. On the right glows a red-orange orb; dark red branches reach toward it from the left. Between them stands one luminous white-blue Y-shaped young tree that catches the branches and keeps them from reaching the orb, like an antibody blocking the signal. Calm, symbolic, minimal.
